Interpretation: De-identified environmental compliance records used for model training and evaluation
Five rule families with five rule templates per family
POP use, storage, exemption, and disposal cases
Mercury release, threshold, and mercury-waste handling cases
ODS license, quota, import, production, and use cases
Cases satisfying rule applicability, obligation, breach, evidence quality, and domestic mapping
Cases with likely breach but incomplete or partially uncertain evidence
Cases where regulated item, controlled action, threshold breach, or obligation is absent
Cases with missing critical fields or invalid evidence quality
Cases with conflicting structured/text evidence or ambiguous domestic mapping
Cases with at least one missing non-output field
Cases where inspection text conflicts with structured evidence
Stratified by rule family and proof state
